senses.gloss: ch. <cite ref="G00173">same</cite>; perf. <cite ref="G00475"><he>זָל</he></cite>, Part. <cite ref="G00352"><he>זִיל</he></cite>, <cite ref="G00176"><he>זוֹל</he></cite>

units: <cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Genesis 16:5">Targ. Y. II, Gen. XVI, 5</cite> (perh. fr. <cite ref="G00499"><he>זְלַל</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 28:68">Targ. Y. Deut. XXVIII, 68</cite> <he>בדמין זוֹלִין</he> for a low price.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 77a:12">B. Mets. 77ᵃ</cite> <he>זל עבידתא</he> (sub <he>שכר</he>) labor has become cheaper.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 77a:8">Ib.</cite> <he>זל עביד׳ מעיקרא</he> labor was originally cheap.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 77a">Ib.</cite> <he>זיל עביד׳</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 40).

<cite ref="Berakhot 63a">Ber. 63ᵃ</cite> (prov.) <he>זָלָא קמץ קניה</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>זָלַת קבוץ קנה מינה</he>, Ar. <cite ref="S01721"><he>קפוץ</he></cite>) if a thing is cheap, be quick and buy it.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 64a:11">B. Mets. 64ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>אי יקרא אי זילא וכ׳</he> whether it will rise or fall, it shall be in my possession (gain or loss shall be mine).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 70a:1">Ab. Zar. 70ᵃ</cite> <he>זִילָה עלייהו</he> she is contemptible in their sight.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 110a:5">B. Bath. 110ᵃ</cite> <he>זִילָא בי מילתא</he> such occupation is beneath my dignity.

<cite ref="Yevamot 63a:9">Yeb. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>זַבֵּין ולא תֵיזוּל</he> sell (part of thy clothes to start a business) in order not to be disgraced by poverty; (oth. explan., v. <cite ref="G00175">next w.</cite>).
B. Mets. 77ᵃ אוֹזִילו אינהו גביה זוזא וכ׳ at the start they had agreed to work for one zuz less (than the market price of labor), and wages were generally reduced afterwards.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 77b:11">Ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>אוֹזְלֵי מוֹזִיל וכ׳</he> he will lower the price and sell (some of his movable goods in order to raise money).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 73a:10">Ib. 73ᵃ</cite> top <he>מוֹזְלֵי גבייהו</he> they will be easier in selling them.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 73a:10">Ib.</cite> bot. <he>אוזולי דקא מוזלי גבייכו</he> (better <he>אחולי … מחלי</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 1) they are liberal towards you (paying more than the ordinary wages).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39:11">Gen. R. s. 39</cite> <he>חלא מֵזִיל חמרא</he> vinegar cheapens wine, i.e. where bad wine is plentiful in the market, good wine sells cheaper; a. fr.
<cite ref="Ketubot 53b:5">Keth. 53ᵇ</cite> <he>לא ניחא ליה דתִיתְּזִיל</he> he does not want her to be disgraced (by dependence on public charity).
